kanatoko set in a stump in front of the fire; the smith sits / kneels on the bellows side
mizu-oke quench tub beside the forge
pine charcoal bin / bales on the back wall (the back door stays clear)
finished hoes, sickles and tongs hung on the front wall's inside (wall-hung props)
